title: Te Māra i Ngaro i te Pō
intro: Whakaarohia he māra momona, kī tonu i ngā hua e pakari haere ana, ā, e karapotia ana e ngā rākau teitei. Ko te hunga i tiaki i taua māra i whakaaro he mātau rātou, e whakamahere ana i ā rātou kotinga i ngā hāora marino i mua i te ata, kia matara atu i ngā kanohi o te hunga e matea ana. Engari ko te Mea e kore e moe, he mahere anō āna mō ā rātou taonga huna. Ka taea e koe te matapae ko wai kei muri i tēnei kōrero whakatūpato mai i te Quran?
clues: I a mātou tētahi māra i mua, he nui ngā mea momona, ā, i hae ai te hunga katoa e haere ana.
I a mātou e whakamahere ana, i kōrero pōhēhē mātou tetahi ki tetahi i te atatu, me te kī kāore he wairua rawakore e whakaaetia kia tomo ki roto i taua rā.
He hunga whai rawa mātou, ā, kua matapo ō mātou ngākau ki ngā tika o te hunga rawakore i tō mātou taha.
I te taenga mai o te ata o te kotinga i whakaarohia e mātou, ka whakatata atu mātou ki tā mātou māra, ā, i te pō kotahi kua huri hei ururua mangu.
I puta mai tētahi ture whakangaro, ā, ko ngā pungarehu anake i mahue i te wāhi i iri ai ngā tautau hua pakari.
He whakatūpato pakari tā tātou kōrero i roto i te Quran, e mōhiotia ana tātou ko ngā rangatira o te māra i kore e atawhai i te hunga rawakore.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Ngā Rangatira o te Māra
Te Iwi o te Ana
Ngā Ākonga a Ihaia
Ngā Hoa o te Ngāhere
Ngā Manuhiri o Ibrahim

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te hauhake puku i ngā hua, me te aukati i te hunga rawakore
Te moe mō ngā rautau i roto i te ana
Te kore e hanga he kamera uha mai i te kōhatu
Te karakia ki tētahi kuao kau koura i Maunga Hinai
Te hanga i tētahi āka nui hei mawhiti i te waipuke
trial.answer: Te hauhake puku i ngā hua, me te aukati i te hunga rawakore

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He māra taiepa kī tonu i ngā nikau me ngā waina
He ana pōuri i roto i ngā maunga
He tāone i pāngia e te awhiowhio atua
He awaawa tapu e tata ana ki te Whare o Allah
Ngā pareparenga o te awa e rere ana
location.answer: He māra taiepa kī tonu i ngā nikau me ngā waina

outcome.label: Hua
options: I pau te māra i te ture werawera mai i te rangi
I moe marie rātou mō ngā tau 309 o te marama
I pakaru rātou i te ua o ngā kōhatu
I toremi rātou i raro i ngā ngaru o te waipuke nui
I marara noa atu rātou i te pupuhi o te hau makariri, te hau kaha
outcome.answer: I pau te māra i te ture werawera mai i te rangi

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew. (68:33)
